import requests, numpy as np, json, time, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
t0=time.time()
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
 'LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def fetch_raw(pid):
    r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60)
    if r.status_code==200 and not r.text.lstrip().startswith('<'): return 'pdb',r.text
    return 'cif',requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=60).text
def finalize(ch):
    return {c:[{'resi':int(k[0]),'icode':k[1],'resn':v['resn'],'aa':AA3.get(v['resn'],'X'),'atoms':v['atoms']}
               for k,v in sorted(d.items(),key=lambda x:(int(x[0][0]),x[0][1]))] for c,d in ch.items()}
def parse_pdb_text(txt):
    ch={}; het=[]
    for l in txt.split('\n'):
        rec=l[:6].strip()
        if rec not in ('ATOM','HETATM') or len(l)<54: continue
        if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        resn=l[17:20].strip(); chain=l[21]; resi=l[22:26].strip(); ic=l[26]
        name=l[12:16].strip(); xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
        if rec=='HETATM' and resn not in AA3: het.append((chain,resn,resi,name,xyz)); continue
        ch.setdefault(chain,{}).setdefault((resi,ic),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][name]=xyz
    return finalize(ch),het
def parse_cif_text(txt):
    lines=txt.split('\n'); i=0; ch={}; het=[]
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols=[]
            while lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}
            while i<len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('#'):
                f=lines[i].split()
                if len(f)<len(cols): i+=1; continue
                if f[idx['label_alt_id']] not in ('.','A'): i+=1; continue
                if 'pdbx_PDB_model_num' in idx and f[idx['pdbx_PDB_model_num']]!='1': i+=1; continue
                grp=f[idx['group_PDB']]; resn=f[idx['label_comp_id']]
                chain=f[idx.get('auth_asym_id',idx['label_asym_id'])]; resi=f[idx.get('auth_seq_id',idx['label_seq_id'])]
                name=f[idx['label_atom_id']].strip('"')
                xyz=[float(f[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_z']])]
                if grp=='HETATM' and resn not in AA3: het.append((chain,resn,resi,name,xyz)); i+=1; continue
                ch.setdefault(chain,{}).setdefault((resi,' '),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][name]=xyz
                i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    return finalize(ch),het
def load(pid):
    f,t=fetch_raw(pid); return parse_pdb_text(t) if f=='pdb' else parse_cif_text(t)
def ca_array(res):
    k=[r for r in res if 'CA' in r['atoms']]; return np.array([r['atoms']['CA'] for r in k],float),k
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def nw_fast(S,g=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); F[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); F[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1); jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        G=np.empty(m+1); G[0]=-1e9; G[1:]=np.maximum(F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],F[i-1,1:]+g)
        b=np.empty(m+1); b[0]=F[i,0]; b[1:]=G[1:]-g*jj[1:]
        F[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(b)+g*jj
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i,j-1]+g))<1e-9: j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        else: i-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
def tmalign(Xq,Xt):
    n,m=len(Xq),len(Xt); L=min(n,m); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
    seeds=[(i,j,Ls) for Ls in [L,L//2] for i in range(0,n-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2)) for j in range(0,m-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2))]
    best=(0,None,None,None)
    for si,sj,Ls in seeds:
        R,t=kabsch(Xq[si:si+Ls],Xt[sj:sj+Ls]); pairs=None
        for it in range(6):
            Xm=Xq@R.T+t; D=np.linalg.norm(Xm[:,None,:]-Xt[None,:,:],axis=2)
            newp=nw_fast(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if pairs==newp: break
            pairs=newp; cur=np.array(pairs)
            for cut in (d0+4,d0+2,d0):
                Xm=Xq@R.T+t; dd=np.linalg.norm(Xm[cur[:,0]]-Xt[cur[:,1]],axis=1); sel=cur[dd<cut]
                if len(sel)<10: break
                R,t=kabsch(Xq[sel[:,0]],Xt[sel[:,1]])
        if not pairs: continue
        Xm=Xq@R.T+t; ix=np.array(pairs); d=np.linalg.norm(Xm[ix[:,0]]-Xt[ix[:,1]],axis=1)
        tm=float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L)
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,pairs,R,t)
    return best
def heavy(res):
    xs=[]
    for r in res:
        for n,x in r['atoms'].items():
            if n[0]!='H': xs.append(x)
    return np.array(xs,float)

DONORS=[('6GSS','A','GSH','GSTP1 pi'),('1EEM','A','GSH','GSTO1 omega'),
        ('2C3Q','A','GTX','GSTT1 theta'),('1LJR','A','GSH','GSTT2 theta')]
TARGETS=[('7AIA','AAA','GDAP1 +HDA'),('7ALM','A','GDAP1 apo'),('6GSS','A','GSTP1 pi'),
         ('1EEM','A','GSTO1 omega'),('2C3Q','A','GSTT1 theta'),('1LJR','A','GSTT2 theta')]
cache={p:load(p) for p in set([d[0] for d in DONORS]+[t[0] for t in TARGETS])}
print("loaded %.0fs"%(time.time()-t0))
rows=[]
for tp,tc,tl in TARGETS:
    tch,thet=cache[tp]; Xq,_=ca_array(tch[tc]); H=heavy(tch[tc]); tr=cKDTree(H)
    for dp,dc,dlig,dl in DONORS:
        L=np.array([h[4] for h in cache[dp][1] if h[1]==dlig and h[0]==dc],float)
        if dp==tp:
            d,_=tr.query(L); tm=1.0
        else:
            Xt,_=ca_array(cache[dp][0][dc]); tm,pairs,R,t=tmalign(Xq,Xt)
            d,_=tr.query((L-t)@R)
        rows.append(dict(target=tl,donor=dl,TM=round(tm,3),n=len(L),
                         frac_clash=round(float((d<2.6).mean()),3),min_d=round(float(d.min()),2),
                         med_d=round(float(np.median(d)),2),self=(dp==tp)))
X=pd.DataFrame(rows)
piv=X.pivot(index='target',columns='donor',values='frac_clash').loc[[t[2] for t in TARGETS]]
tmv=X.pivot(index='target',columns='donor',values='TM').loc[[t[2] for t in TARGETS]]
print("Fraction of transplanted glutathione heavy atoms clashing (<2.6 A):"); print(piv.to_string())
print("\nTM-score of the superposition used:"); print(tmv.to_string())
g=X[X.target.str.startswith('GDAP1') & ~X.self]['frac_clash'].values
s=X[(~X.target.str.startswith('GDAP1')) & ~X.self]['frac_clash'].values
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,p=mannwhitneyu(g,s,alternative='greater')
print("\nGDAP1 targets n=%d mean=%.3f (range %.2f-%.2f); cross-class GST targets n=%d mean=%.3f (range %.2f-%.2f); Mann-Whitney one-sided p=%.4f"
      %(len(g),g.mean(),g.min(),g.max(),len(s),s.mean(),s.min(),s.max(),p))
print("elapsed %.0fs"%(time.time()-t0))
X.to_csv('/tmp/cross.csv',index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.3))
im=axes[0].imshow(piv.values,cmap='magma_r',vmin=0,vmax=0.8,aspect='auto')
axes[0].set_xticks(range(piv.shape[1])); axes[0].set_xticklabels(piv.columns,rotation=25,ha='right')
axes[0].set_yticks(range(piv.shape[0])); axes[0].set_yticklabels(piv.index)
for i in range(piv.shape[0]):
    for j in range(piv.shape[1]):
        axes[0].text(j,i,f"{piv.values[i,j]:.2f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,
                     color='white' if piv.values[i,j]>0.45 else 'black')
axes[0].set_title("Glutathione transplanted onto each target by\nstructural superposition: fraction of GSH atoms clashing")
axes[0].set_xlabel("donor (GSH-bound GST)"); axes[0].set_ylabel("target")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=axes[0],label='fraction of GSH heavy atoms < 2.6 A from protein')
axes[1].boxplot([g,s],labels=['GDAP1\ntargets','other GST\ntargets'],widths=0.5)
axes[1].scatter(np.random.normal(1,0.04,len(g)),g,color='crimson',zorder=3)
axes[1].scatter(np.random.normal(2,0.04,len(s)),s,color='steelblue',zorder=3)
axes[1].set_ylabel("fraction of GSH atoms clashing"); axes[1].set_ylim(-0.02,0.8)
axes[1].set_title("Cross-class transplantation control\nMann-Whitney one-sided p = %.4f"%p)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
